summary: Repository maintenance updated GitHub CLI, LuaJIT and Qt Declarative; conventional verification passed.
changes: Full signed repository upgrade changed only github-cli 2.102.0-1.1 to 2.102.1-1.1, luajit 2.1.1792349434+dd3b243-1.1 to 2.1.1792527110+95f931c-1.1, and qt6-declarative 6.12.0-1.1 to 6.12.0-2.1. Standard package hooks completed. Installed kernels, graphics drivers, repository policy, desktop settings, services and existing jobs were preserved. No reboot or model execution.
tests: Before and after: package database consistency passed, file presence checks passed for thirteen core and affected packages, detailed integrity checks passed for all three affected packages, and GitHub CLI and LuaJIT version checks passed. Qt tooling version checks passed; after upgrade, a minimal QtQml lint check and LuaJIT arithmetic and bit checks passed. Complete inventory comparison found only the three expected version changes; protected configuration hashes and service states were unchanged. Fresh isolated repository check found no remaining updates. No graphical, gaming or performance benchmark was performed.
rollback: Previous signed GitHub CLI and LuaJIT package archives and signatures were preserved and verified. Previous Qt archive download returned HTTP 404; exact installed Qt payload and package metadata were archived and compared without differences. Prefer a signed old Qt package for rollback; selective offline recovery needs dependency assessment. No rollback was necessary.
problem: Existing custom integration acceptance failure remains unresolved; required native evidence is missing. Current desktop differs from the recorded preference. A package mirror returned HTTP 404 for the new LuaJIT archive; another mirror supplied it successfully. The old Qt archive was unavailable for rollback download.
solution: Applied the authorized complete package upgrade and verified the resulting state. Retained integration failure evidence and desktop configuration, with local proposals for a separately authorized capable session. Preserved available rollback material without weakening signature settings.
reproduction: Fresh isolated repository query identified the three updates; the full package transaction completed successfully and a subsequent fresh query found none. Existing custom integration failure remains associated with the same installed application identity; no job was replayed.
